generatedAt.description: ISO time the plan was written

dryRun.description: true means nothing in the plan may be sent

pr.description: repo#number, or a list of them for one message

args.description: send only: the exact arguments for the connector's send-message operation

threadTsFrom.description: send only: id of the action whose sent message's timestamp becomes args.thread_ts

reason.description: skip and hold: why nothing is sent

thread_ts.description: needs-reply only: the thread to answer in

changed.description: needs-reply only: pull request changes to mention in the answer
